notes:
FORMS AND PATTERNS:
- {稀|まれ}な + noun — a rare ~: {稀|まれ}な⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧ (a rare case), {稀|まれ}な⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧ (a rare thing)
- {稀|まれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — rarely, seldom (adverbial): {稀|まれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (rarely seen)
- {稀|まれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — only rarely ~
- {稀|まれ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ / {稀|まれ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ — is rare (predicate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧ emphasizes unusualness or curiosity value; {稀|まれ} is purely about low frequency of occurrence.
- ⟦めったに→滅多に：03806_mettani⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ needs a negative predicate; {稀|まれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ also works in affirmative sentences.
- ⟦たまに→たまに：01276_tamani⟧ means "occasionally" — a low but ordinary frequency. {稀|まれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is lower still and treats the event as exceptional.

REGISTER AND WRITING:
Formal and written-leaning: news reports, official notices, technical and medical description ({稀|まれ}な⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧). In everyday conversation ⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧ and ⟦めったに→滅多に：03806_mettani⟧ are the natural choices. Often written in kana as まれ; {希|まれ} is an accepted variant kanji.
